---
title: "MANO"
subtitle: "Colombian Sign Language Recognition System"
---

## Overview

**MANO** is an open-source system for translating Colombian Sign Language (LSC) into text. It bridges the gap between static alphabet signs and dynamic word gestures using a hybrid pipeline of Computer Vision and Large Language Models.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
### 🎯 Goals
- **Real-time** translation of LSC.
- **Privacy-first** on-device processing.
- **Accessible** via standard webcams.
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
### 🚀 Tech Stack
- **Vision**: MediaPipe & PyTorch.
- **Logic**: Custom BiGRU & Transformer models.
- **Correction**: LLM-based post-processing.
:::

:::

## Key Features

| Feature | Status | Details |
|---------|--------|---------|
| **Letter Recognition** | ✅ Ready | MobileNetV2 (99% acc) |
| **Word Recognition** | 🚧 Beta | BiGRU on Holistic Landmarks |
| **Autocorrect** | ✅ Ready | Trie + LLM (Groq/Ollama) |
| **Web Deployment** | ✅ Live | Docker + FastAPI |
